question: What H98(y,2) values have been reported for ITER-baseline-like H-modes (q95 ~ 3, βN ~ 1.8) at f_GW > 0.8 on JET-ILW, ASDEX Upgrade and DIII-D, and how steeply does H98 degrade with increasing f_GW in those datasets?

How does the measured L-H threshold power P_LH in hydrogen, deuterium, tritium and D-T plasmas on JET compare with the Martin 2008 scaling, i.e. what ratios P_LH/P_Martin and isotope mass dependence were reported?

What range of λq (mm, mapped to outboard midplane) has been measured in inter-ELM H-mode at high poloidal field (Bpol > 1 T, e.g. C-Mod) and how well does the Eich multi-machine scaling λq ∝ Bpol^-1.2 hold there and at high separatrix density?

What runaway-electron plateau currents and current conversion fractions I_RE/I_p0 have been reported for argon-induced disruptions on JET-ILW and DIII-D, and how does conversion depend on pre-disruption plasma current?

What deuterium retention (trapped D concentration in at.%) has been measured in tungsten pre-damaged by self-ion or neutron irradiation, as a function of damage level in dpa, and at what dpa does it saturate?

What dimensionless ECCD efficiencies ζ_CD have been measured on DIII-D, TCV and ASDEX Upgrade for off-axis current drive (ρ ~ 0.4–0.7), and how do they compare with ray-tracing/Fokker-Planck predictions including trapped-particle effects?

What peak triple product n·T_i·τE and energy confinement times have been reported on W7-X (OP1.2 and OP2 campaigns), and what ISS04 renormalization factors f_ren were obtained in the best pellet-fuelled discharges?

What collisionality dependence of normalized confinement (B·τE ∝ ν*^α) has been reported in NSTX and MAST/MAST-U H-modes, what values of α were found, and are they robust between boronized and lithiated wall conditions?
What are the reported fusion yields, target gains (yield/laser energy on target) and laser energies for NIF ignition shots since December 2022, and what is the highest target gain published so far?

What tritium burn fraction and fuelling efficiency values are assumed or derived in EU-DEMO and compact high-field pilot plant designs, and what required tritium breeding ratio ranges result from published fuel-cycle models?

What is the current state of evidence on the isotope effect on energy confinement in H-mode and L-mode (H vs D vs T vs D-T on JET, AUG, DIII-D, JT-60U)? Where does it contradict naive gyro-Bohm scaling, and is the effect attributed mainly to the pedestal or the core?

Which small-ELM or ELM-free regimes (QH-mode, I-mode, EDA H-mode, grassy ELMs, QCE/type-II) have been demonstrated with metal walls at low pedestal collisionality and ITER-relevant q95, and on which devices?

What evidence exists that machine-learning disruption predictors trained on one tokamak transfer to another (e.g. DIII-D, C-Mod, EAST, JET), what warning times and true/false positive rates were achieved cross-device, and how much target-device data was needed?

How much do alternative divertor configurations (snowflake on TCV/DIII-D, Super-X on MAST-U, X-divertor) actually lower the detachment onset upstream density or widen the detachment window compared with a conventional divertor, and do measurements agree with SOLPS predictions?

Has tungsten fuzz or He-induced nanostructure been observed on tokamak-exposed tungsten (e.g. C-Mod, DIII-D DiMES, AUG, WEST) as opposed to linear plasma devices, and how do observed growth conditions compare with linear-device thresholds (surface temperature, He ion energy, fluence)?
What has been measured on Alfvén eigenmode activity and alpha-particle or fast-ion losses during the JET D-T campaigns (DTE2/DTE3), and was any alpha-driven TAE unambiguously identified?

What validation studies compare measured pedestal turbulence (BES, GPI, Doppler backscattering, reflectometry) with gyrokinetic simulations, which instabilities (MTM, KBM, ETG, TEM) were identified, and how good was the agreement?

What is the evidence that ion heat transport in W7-X is dominated by turbulence rather than neoclassical transport, what is the observed central T_i clamping value, and which scenarios (pellets, NBI, density peaking) have overcome it?
What changes to target design, capsule thickness or laser energy on NIF in 2024–2026 produced the latest record yields, and what yields were achieved with the upgraded laser energy?
What were the main results from MAST-U campaigns in 2023–2025 on Super-X divertor detachment and H-mode access, and what is the reported status of NSTX-U recovery and first plasma?
What has been published 2024–2026 on SPARC's HTS magnet programme (TFMC test results, quench and damage findings, CSMC tests) and its assembly/commissioning schedule?

What plasma conditions (heating power, density, T_e, H-mode or L-mode, wall temperature control) were reported for the long-pulse records on EAST and WEST in 2024–2025, and what limited the pulse length?

What results have been reported since 2023 on ITER-relevant diagnostics tested during the JET D-T campaigns, such as neutron cameras, gamma-ray spectroscopy for alpha particles, and radiation-hard bolometers or magnetics?

What did the 2024 ITER re-baseline change regarding first-wall material and the disruption mitigation system, and which shattered pellet injection results from JET, DIII-D, KSTAR or AUG since 2023 informed the DMS design?
Has anyone achieved full type-I ELM suppression with RMPs in a tungsten-wall tokamak at ITER-relevant low pedestal collisionality (ν*_ped < 0.5) and q95 ≈ 3, or only ELM mitigation?
Is there evidence that negative-triangularity plasmas reach H98 ≈ 1 confinement without ELMs at high normalized beta (βN > 2) and high heating power, e.g. on DIII-D or TCV?

Has anyone demonstrated a flowing or capillary-porous liquid-metal (Li or Sn) divertor target in a tokamak handling steady heat fluxes above 10 MW/m², and what were the impurity contamination consequences?
Has the three-ion ICRF heating scheme been used to generate MeV-range fast ions in a stellarator (e.g. W7-X), and were their confinement or losses measured?
Has any laser direct-drive implosion reached a burning-plasma state, and what is the highest hydro-equivalent extrapolated yield to MJ-scale laser energy reported from OMEGA cryogenic DT implosions?

Has reinforcement-learning-based control been applied in real plasma experiments on tokamaks other than TCV, and has it been used for anything beyond magnetic shape control, such as tearing-mode avoidance or profile control?
